# Operator product expansion

Claims from wiphy.org for the planned OPE module.

claims.name: ope_convergent_cft
claims.statement: The operator product expansion in conformal field theories is proved to be convergent rather than merely asymptotic as in non-conformal field theories.

claims.name: ope_convergent_finiteSeparation
claims.statement: In CFT, the OPE (Operator Product Expansion) is convergent at finite point separation, not just asymptotic

sources.title: EPFL Lectures on Conformal Field Theory in D>= 3 Dimensions

claims.name: ope_primary_form
claims.statement: The OPE is $O_i(x) O_j(y) = \frac{\delta_{ij}}{\left\lvert x-y \right\rvert^{2 \Delta_i}} + \frac{C^{k}_{ij}\, O_k(x)}{\left\lvert x-y \right\rvert^{\Delta_i+ \Delta_j - \Delta_k}} + \ldots \qquad \text{as $x \to y$}\,$
